selected.title: The Clearing House taps Quant for tokenised deposit network
selected.summary: The Clearing House has picked UK-based programmable money infrastructure provider Quant to power a new interoperable payments network that will enable US financial institutions of all sizes to clear and settle tokenised deposit transactions.
selected.why: The Clearing House launches new tokenised deposit network, a significant US payments infrastructure move.

reason: US tokenised deposit network launch raises real questions about whether private infrastructure can compete with central bank solutions, as demonstrated by ECB's parallel Pontes effort.
angle: The Clearing House's private tokenised settlement network will fail because central banks have superior incentives to build interoperable infrastructure.
